Poltergeist (CV 18)

Chairs scrape and small objects tremble around a wavering figure, while dust outlines spectral hands that cannot hold still.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 18 · Speed: 6; fly 6 · Footprint: 1x1

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: 1 Boon. · Stability: 0.

DR / resistance: Physical 1 · Condition immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body. Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: Common; understands old oaths

Eligibility: Spirit 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use the controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or if the controller is unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot. No summon chains.

Carrying: At most 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No crafting training.

Against offensive healing: Fortitude defense; ordinary player attacks still use the defense attribute named on that attack.

Lifeless Body — Passive: Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
Hurled keepsakeBrawnNone2 physical damage.4 physical damage. Push 1.6 physical damage. Push 3.

Hurled keepsake: Requires an unattended object of at most 1 Bulk within 3 squares of the poltergeist. The attack moves that object; it cannot take a held item. One visible creature within 6 squares. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

Maneuvers

Rattle the Room: Move one unattended object of at most 1 Bulk within 3 squares into an empty square adjacent to its starting square. Cannot harm a creature, take a held item, trigger an attack or move anything fixed in place.

Defend: Gain 1 Boon to defenses until the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: Brawn None; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.
